charities.name: Access to Medicines Initiative (AMI)
charities.blurb: Reduces maternal mortality and supports women's autonomy by tackling contraceptive stockouts and ensuring supply in public health facilities.

charities.name: Acción Transformadora (ACTRA)
charities.blurb: Implements and scales cognitive behavioural therapy programmes proven to cut violent crime and reoffending, starting in Colombia.

charities.name: Alliance for Reducing Microbial Resistance
charities.blurb: Supports sustainable access to, and the development of, antimicrobials to combat antimicrobial resistance, with a focus on pull incentives.

charities.name: Animal Advocacy Careers
charities.blurb: Speeds up the end of unnecessary animal suffering by matching people to the roles that help animals most, through courses, a job board, career advising and recruitment support.

charities.name: Animal Ask
charities.blurb: Conducts in-depth research to help animal charities, donors and policymakers choose and prioritise the farmed animal welfare asks that will do the most good.

charities.name: Animal Policy International
charities.blurb: Ensures animal welfare standards are upheld in international trade policy, so that imports meet the same standards as domestic production.

charities.name: Ansh
charities.blurb: Builds healthcare capacity in India so mothers can provide Kangaroo Care, a simple, scientifically proven treatment that averts newborn deaths.

charities.name: Ark Philanthropy
charities.blurb: A philanthropic institution that partners with ambitious funders to solve the most important problems of our time, identifying promising people and building grantmaking infrastructure.

charities.name: Benefficienza
charities.blurb: Promotes effective giving in Italy, helping donors direct their contributions to the charities with the greatest impact.

charities.name: Better Futures Guide
charities.blurb: A dedicated livelihoods evaluator that synthesises research to identify the highest-impact charities helping people increase their income, and publishes recommendations for donors.

charities.name: Better Season Project
charities.blurb: Helps smallholder farmers in Kenya escape poverty by offering asset-collateralised loans for proven, income-raising tools such as water tanks and storage bags, in partnership with savings and credit cooperatives.

charities.name: Canopie
charities.blurb: A scalable, cost-effective digital programme to prevent and treat perinatal mood disorders such as postpartum depression.

charities.name: Center for Alcohol Policy Solutions
charities.blurb: An evidence-based non-profit that worked to save lives and promote wellbeing through alcohol taxation, the single most effective policy for reducing alcohol-related harm.

charities.name: Center for Effective Aid Policy
charities.blurb: Advocated for governments to spend the $180 billion annual development aid budget more cost-effectively.

charities.name: Centre for Aquaculture Progress
charities.blurb: An independent research think tank that accelerates the adoption of science-based, practical fish welfare improvements in European aquaculture.

charities.name: Centre for Exploratory Altruism Research (CEARCH)
charities.blurb: A research and grantmaking organisation that searches for and funds highly cost-effective philanthropic ideas in neglected cause areas.

charities.name: Charity Science Health
charities.blurb: Sent SMS reminders for routine childhood immunisations in India; merged into Suvita in 2020.

charities.name: Clear Solutions
charities.blurb: Prevents child deaths from diarrhoeal disease in Nigeria by distributing free oral rehydration salts and zinc door-to-door through community health workers.

charities.name: Concentric Policies
charities.blurb: Prevents and controls non-communicable diseases through data-driven policymaking, starting with tobacco taxation in high-burden countries.

charities.name: Ellis Impact
charities.blurb: A New York-based philanthropy advisory that gives large donors strategic advice and tailored grant portfolios so they can give more effectively.

charities.name: Family Empowerment Media
charities.blurb: Prevents maternal deaths from unintended pregnancies by producing radio ads and shows that improve knowledge, attitudes and behaviour around family planning in Nigeria.

charities.name: FarmKind
charities.blurb: An online donation platform that connects donors with the most effective farmed animal charities, helping close the funding gap for the best-evidenced animal welfare work.

charities.name: First Embrace
charities.blurb: Establishes Kangaroo Mother Care wards in hospitals, training nurses to provide skin-to-skin contact and breastfeeding support that saves the lives of low birth weight newborns.

charities.name: Fish Welfare Initiative
charities.blurb: Works with farmers, corporations and governments to improve the welfare of farmed fish as much as possible, with a focus on Asia.

charities.name: Fortify Health
charities.blurb: Prevents and reduces anaemia at scale in India by fortifying wheat flour with iron, folic acid and vitamin B12, reaching millions of people every month.

charities.name: Giving Green
charities.blurb: An evidence-based guide that helps donors and businesses fight climate change by identifying the most impactful climate giving opportunities.

charities.name: Good Policies
charities.blurb: Worked on tobacco taxation policy in Mongolia to reduce smoking-related deaths.

charities.name: Happier Lives Institute
charities.blurb: Connects donors, researchers and policymakers with the most cost-effective opportunities to increase global wellbeing, using subjective wellbeing data to find the problems that matter most to people.

charities.name: Healthier Hens
charities.blurb: Worked to improve the welfare of egg-laying hens through cost-effective dietary interventions, piloting feed fortification in Kenya.

charities.name: HealthLearn
charities.blurb: Provides high-quality online training to health workers in developing countries, a 'Duolingo for healthcare' that improves quality of care and prevents newborn deaths.

charities.name: Healthy Futures Global
charities.blurb: Prevents mother-to-child transmission of syphilis by expanding access to dual HIV/syphilis testing and treatment for pregnant women.

charities.name: High Impact Professionals
charities.blurb: Enables working professionals to maximise their positive impact by supporting them to donate their time, skills and resources effectively.

charities.name: Impactful Giving
charities.blurb: Helps donors in India make good decisions about their giving, with a curated platform of evidence-backed opportunities and a personalised advisory service.

charities.name: Institute for Development Innovation
charities.blurb: Improves the cost-effectiveness of India's welfare spending by giving leaders evidence-based, electorally viable policy alternatives backed by polling and implementation support.

charities.name: Kaya Guides
charities.blurb: Reduces depression among young people in India through a WhatsApp-based guided self-help programme with weekly support calls from lay counsellors.

charities.name: Lafiya Nigeria
charities.blurb: Reduces maternal mortality in rural northern Nigeria by equipping local nurses and midwives to provide safe family planning options, including self-injectable contraceptives.

charities.name: Lead Acid Battery Recycling Initiative (LABRI)
charities.blurb: Tackles lead exposure from unsafe recycling of used lead-acid batteries in low- and middle-income countries by partnering with governments and generating evidence on solutions.

charities.name: Lead Exposure Elimination Project (LEEP)
charities.blurb: Drives effective policies to eliminate lead poisoning across the globe, with a current focus on ending the sale and manufacture of lead paint.

charities.name: Lead Research for Action (LeRA)
charities.blurb: Conducts lead content studies on consumer products in low- and middle-income countries to identify and help eliminate the main drivers of childhood lead poisoning.

charities.name: Learning Alliance
charities.blurb: Tackles the foundational learning crisis in sub-Saharan Africa by bringing evidence-based teaching practices into classrooms and supporting teachers to give every child an excellent education.

charities.name: Maternal Health Initiative
charities.blurb: Worked to improve women's health, agency and income by raising the quality of contraceptive counselling and integrating family planning into postpartum care in Ghana and Sierra Leone.

charities.name: Mieux Donner
charities.blurb: Informs and inspires people in France and French-speaking Switzerland to donate effectively, directing their gifts to the charities with the greatest impact.

charities.name: Notify Health
charities.blurb: Increases life-saving childhood vaccination coverage in sub-Saharan Africa by sending well-evidenced, low-cost reminder messages to caregivers.

charities.name: Novah
charities.blurb: Novah, short for No Violence at Home, works to prevent intimate partner violence against women through evidence-based mass media campaigns.

charities.name: Opal Health
charities.blurb: Prevents maternal and newborn deaths in East Africa through Participatory Learning and Action groups, where women and families identify barriers to care and build community solutions alongside government health systems.

charities.name: Oxygen Access Project
charities.blurb: Improves access to medical oxygen in hospitals for children in low- and middle-income countries, where four out of five children who need oxygen do not receive it.

charities.name: Policy Entrepreneurship Network
charities.blurb: Worked to accelerate innovation in neglected areas of public health policy, such as tobacco and alcohol taxation, in the EU's eastern neighbourhood.

charities.name: Radius Institute for Road Safety
charities.blurb: Provides local data, evidence-based insights and hands-on technical assistance to end road traffic deaths and serious injuries, with a focus on speed management in low- and middle-income countries.

charities.name: Respira Health
charities.blurb: Brings digital pulmonary rehabilitation to people with COPD in low- and middle-income countries, where 90% of the disease's 3 million annual deaths occur and access to treatment is severely limited.

charities.name: SafeStart
charities.blurb: Expands access to safe drinking water in rural Kano State, Nigeria, through a community-based chlorine access model that combines behaviour change with reliable last-mile distribution.

charities.name: Scale Welfare
charities.blurb: Improves the welfare of farmed fish in Asia, working with milkfish farmers in the Philippines and pangasius exporters in Vietnam.

charities.name: Setuwelt
charities.blurb: Connects underprivileged Indian youth to Germany's apprenticeship programme through language training, cultural integration and mentorship, opening a pathway to skilled long-term employment.

charities.name: Shrimp Welfare Project
charities.blurb: Aims to improve the lives of billions of farmed shrimps by partnering with producers to reduce stocking densities, end eyestalk ablation and adopt electrical stunning at slaughter.

charities.name: Spiro
charities.blurb: Expands tuberculosis prevention and care in Pakistan by screening household contacts of people with TB and offering preventive treatment, with a special focus on children under five.

charities.name: Stronger Flocks
charities.blurb: Works to update egg certification standards so they include an outcome-based limit on keel bone fractures, one of the most widespread welfare problems affecting laying hens.

charities.name: Suvita
charities.blurb: Works alongside governments in India to increase uptake of childhood immunisations through SMS reminders to parents and a network of community immunisation ambassadors.

charities.name: Taimaka
charities.blurb: Has reimagined paediatric malnutrition treatment in Nigeria, making it more cost-effective and scalable by simplifying protocols so community health workers can deliver care.

charities.name: The Mission Motor
charities.blurb: Supports farmed and wild animal advocacy organisations to build monitoring, evaluation and learning systems so they can continuously improve their impact.

charities.name: Training for Good
charities.blurb: An impact-focused training organisation that ran fellowships placing talented professionals into impactful careers in European policy and AI governance.

charities.name: Vida Plena
charities.blurb: Builds strong mental health in Latin America by delivering group-based therapy for depression through trained community facilitators in Ecuador.
